row.evidence: Infor sells HCM only through sales ("Contact us and we'll have a Business Development Representative contact you"), and the Infor OS Security guide documents a SCIM service whose user identifiers and passwords are used in a third-party SCIM application to load users into Infor OS Portal.
row.notes: Quote-only: Infor HCM (CloudSuite HCM, Global HR) has no public price list; the HCM page offers Contact Us and Watch demo. Users for Infor CloudSuite apps, including HCM, live in Infor OS Security (formerly Infor Federation Services, IFS), which runs the SCIM service: admins add a SCIM user identifier and password under Security > Manage > SCIM Accounts, and Entra sends Base64(identifier:password) as the bearer token to a tenant URL ending /v2/scim. SCIM groups carry security-role, location and group associations to their members. Okta (OIN 'Infor CloudSuite', SCIM create/update/deactivate/group push) and Entra (gallery app with user and group provisioning, Infor extension attributes) both provision. A tenant setting can create SCIM-provisioned users in Draft status. SAML 2.0 federation with the customer's IdP is configured in Infor OS Security. Programmatic user management is also offered through IFS APIs (endpoints not in the loaded pages).

plans.name: Infor CloudSuite HCM
plans.notes: No public tiers. SCIM and SAML are Infor OS platform features; whether every HCM subscription includes them is not stated.

auth.token_source: Security > Manage > SCIM Accounts: Add new item, set a SCIM password; a SCIM user identifier is generated. Token = Base64(User Identifier:SCIM Password)
auth.notes: Deleting a SCIM user identifier breaks any SCIM client configured with it. The SCIM Service option can be disabled, which hides SCIM accounts. Requires the IFSApplicationAdmin or UserAdmin role.

operations.notes: Create/update/deactivate and group push come from the Okta OIN capability list and Entra's tutorial ('create, update, and disable users and/or groups'); Infor's own page says SCIM deprovisioning 'removes access when users leave'.

deprovision.notes: Infor describes deprovisioning only as removing access; whether the user is set inactive or deleted is not stated. Entra disables users.

custom.how: Infor extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:infor:2.0:User with actorId, federationId, ifsPersonId, lnUser, userAlias

attributes.notes: From Microsoft's Entra attribute mapping for the Infor CloudSuite gallery app.

roles.how: SCIM groups are pushed from the IdP; in Infor OS Security, admins map security roles, functional security roles, accounting entities, LN user data defaults sets, groups and locations to each SCIM group, and members inherit them.

limitations.text: Associations inherited from a SCIM group cannot be deleted on the user's own details page, only from the SCIM group.
With 'Create Users In Draft Status' enabled, SCIM-created users get Draft status and cannot log in until activated.
Entra: users assigned with the Default Access role are excluded from provisioning; a valid app-specific role must be chosen.

scim.notes: base_url is the example tenant URL printed in Microsoft's Entra tutorial; the SCIM Accounts page in Infor OS shows each tenant's SCIM service URLs. version 2.0 inferred from the /v2/scim path and the enterprise 2.0 extension in Entra's mapping.

auth.notes: The Security APIs page lists bearer tokens, OAuth2 scopes, service accounts and client-credentials grants.

user_api.notes: Infor OS Security says IFS APIs enable programmatic user management and that Infor OS APIs create and manage users, roles and service accounts; specific endpoints were not found in the loaded pages.

okta.notes: OIN page 'Infor CloudSuite' (rendered DOM) marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking checked.

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Infor CloudSuite' with user and group provisioning; SAML SSO configured separately.

fallbacks.other_sync: Import file for bulk user creation; Sync.SecurityUserMaster BOD syncs users provisioned in another Infor application; IFS APIs
fallbacks.notes: Federated identities via SAML 2.0 are configured in Infor OS Security (Identity Providers).

Infor's docs do not say whether SCIM deprovisioning sets users inactive or deletes them, or whether it frees a licence.
SCIM filtering, pagination, PATCH/PUT support, ServiceProviderConfig and rate limits are not documented in the pages found.
IFS user-management API endpoints were not located in public docs.
